newsitem.title: USA: Apache sees EPS rising sharply -- report.
newsitem.headline: Apache sees EPS rising sharply -- report.

text.p: Apache Corp's internal projections show the company's net topping $100 million, or more than $1.00 a share, compared with last year's profits of $20.2 million, or $0.28 a share, Barron's weekly said.
The report, based on an interview with Apache chief executive Raymond Plank, also said the company's internal estimates predict its net will exceed $145 million, or $1.50 per share, in 1997.
The newspaper also said Plank estimates the company's revenues should approach $900 million this year and top $1 billion in 1997, compared to $751 million in 1995.
Cash flow is expected to reach $495 million this year and over $600 million in 1997 versus $356 million in 1995, according to the newspaper's Sept. 9 issue.
The independent oil and gas producer's strong outlook is driven by sharp gains in output and recent acquisitions, the financial weekly said.
